# Review

## Outcome

**Approved**

## Evidence

- All 6 acceptance-criteria tests pass in tank_data: test_provenance_schema_roundtrip (AC1), test_provenance_optional_fields (AC2), test_confidence_levels_enum (AC3), test_valid_range_enforcement (AC4), test_backward_compatible_loading (AC5), test_provenance_display (AC6).
- 11 provenance unit tests pass in tank_core covering ConfidenceLevel roundtrip, unknown rejection, ParamMeta display (full and empty), range check (in-range, out-of-range, no-range, non-finite value, invalid range), and format_param (with and without notes).
- NaN/non-finite guard implemented in check_param_range (provenance.rs:140-146): non-finite values now produce a warning with distinct 'non-finite' message. Inverted range guard at provenance.rs:133-139 catches lo > hi with 'invalid valid_range' message. Both have dedicated tests.
- Legacy total-style normalization implemented via provenance_value() -> normalize_process_param_for_provenance() pipeline (presets.rs:535-542, 796-806). All legacy _mg parameters (aob_k_tan_mg, decomposer_k_doc_mg, etc.) are divided by LEGACY_KINETIC_REFERENCE_VOLUME_L before display/range-check. preserve_non_finite_division() (presets.rs:853-858) retains NaN/inf for diagnostic paths. Covered by test_process_preset_format_param_normalizes_legacy_total_units.
- Preset-level Provenance.confidence documented as intentionally freeform (presets.rs:18-20 doc comment), distinct from per-parameter ParamMeta.confidence which uses the validated ConfidenceLevel enum. Covered by test_preset_level_provenance_confidence_is_freeform.
- death_biomass_to_detritus_fraction and all 4 microfauna routing fractions now present in ProcessParamsPreset struct (presets.rs:381-401) with serde defaults, included in param_value() lookup (presets.rs:514, 521-530), and tested in test_backward_compatible_loading (presets.rs:1488-1492).
- ProcessParamsPreset::validate() rejects unknown param_meta keys (presets.rs:862-869). ParamMeta uses #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)] (provenance.rs:40). Both guard against typos/invalid metadata.
- All public types properly exported: tank_core::types::mod.rs re-exports ConfidenceLevel, ParamMeta, RangeWarning, check_param_range, check_all_ranges, format_param. tank_data::lib.rs re-exports the same for external consumers.
- Full test suite green: 45 tank_core lib + 16 tank_data lib + 3 tank_scenarios lib + 13 budget_helpers + 24 budget_tracking + 16 shrimp_population = 117 tests, 0 failures.

## Findings and Gaps

- No TOML data files currently contain [param_meta.*] sections — the provenance infrastructure is ready but actual metadata attachment is deferred to the downstream bead tanksim-6e5.7.2. This is expected per the project design.
- Preset-level Provenance.confidence remains Option<String> rather than Option<ConfidenceLevel>. The distinction is now documented in a doc comment (presets.rs:18-20), which satisfies the amendment requirement for explicit documentation of the intentional divergence.
- The valid_range check at presets.rs:1412 asserts warnings[0].value == 10.0 for a raw aob_k_tan_mg of 200.0 — this is correct because the legacy normalization divides by 20.0 (LEGACY_KINETIC_REFERENCE_VOLUME_L), yielding 10.0. The test correctly validates that range checks operate on normalized values, not raw stored values.

## Follow-up and Amendments

None.
